title: Iterated simulation by placed configurations
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers, let $S,H$ be types, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let a placement consist of an injection from the $k$ source tape indices into the $l$ host tape indices and an exact selector for its occupied indices. Suppose the state map $S\to H$ is injective, and there is a predicate on source states such that, whenever that predicate holds at a source state $q$, the host transition from its mapped state agrees on every input symbol and host tape-symbol tuple with the placed action corresponding to the source transition at $q$. Given host tape contents and head positions, a source configuration $c$, and a natural number $t$, if every state reached from $c$ at each time $j<t$ satisfies the predicate whenever that configuration is in a source state, then running the host machine for $t$ steps from the placed configuration equals placing the source machine's configuration after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A placement with an injection and an exact selector
Transition agreement at every predicate-satisfying source state, for all inputs and host tape-symbol tuples
Host tape contents and head positions
Predicate guard for every time $j<t$ at which the source configuration has a state
